data.title: The SEC Cleared XRP, Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana for Nasdaq Texas Commodity Trusts. What It Does and Does Not Do.
data.description: Social media erupted over an SEC order that appeared to declare XRP, Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana official commodities under federal law. The reality is far more limited, and far more interesting, than the headlines suggest.
data.keywords: XRP, Solana, Nasdaq, Ethereum, SEC, Bitcoin, rule change
